churn_resistance.rationale: Data access, formatting and configuration are each behind one module, so a framework or API change touches few files; the deductions are duplicated card/CSS construction and the absence of any type annotations at the API boundary.

findings.issue: goto() is called with SvelteKit 2 options (keepFocus, noScroll, replaceState). SvelteKit 3 removed keepFocus/noScroll in favour of reset:false and renamed replaceState to replace; the Kit 3.1.0 production router never reads them, so every debounced search commit, filter change and game change blurs the search input and scrolls to top (replaceState only survives via an undocumented fallback).
findings.suggestion: Use `await goto(url, { reset: false, replace: true })` in app/src/routes/+page.svelte:34 and app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:12 (Kit 3 migration guide, svelte.dev/e/kit/goto_options_removed).

findings.issue: The home load constructs card objects and the sprite URL inline, duplicating spriteUrl/buildCard in src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:146-166; hiddenCard is itself a copy of buildCard. The 'card' concept now has two constructors that can drift.
findings.suggestion: Reuse buildCards/spriteUrl from the data module so card shape and sprite URLs live in one place; collapse hiddenCard into buildCard.

findings.issue: API_BASE_URL is read straight from process.env, bypassing SvelteKit 3's explicit environment-variable system (src/env.js with defineEnvVars + $app/env/private, which replaces the $env/* modules slated for removal in Kit 4); the value is never validated and the module is hard-coupled to Node's process.
findings.suggestion: Declare API_BASE_URL in a src/env.js (with a URL-schema validator, defaulting to http://localhost:9000) and import it from $app/env/private, which adapter-node resolves at request time.

findings.issue: Subpath imports omit the module extension ('#lib/format', not '#lib/format.js'), which the Kit 3 migration guide calls out as required when switching $lib to #lib; it resolves today only because Vite completes the extension.
findings.suggestion: Write '#lib/format.js' and '#lib/components/...svelte' consistently in all imports.

findings.issue: idFromUrl extracts ids from API URLs with a hand-rolled regex instead of the URL standard.
findings.suggestion: Parse with `new URL(url).pathname.match(/\/(\d+)\/?$/)` or split the pathname — the regex on the full href string also matches digits in query strings or hashes.

findings.issue: The .facts/.facts dt/.facts dd rules are duplicated verbatim (and mis-indented) inside the @media (max-width: 700px) block, an accidental copy-paste that future edits will fix in one place and not the other.
findings.suggestion: Delete the duplicated block at app.css:685-701.

findings.issue: No JSDoc/type annotations at the PokeAPI boundary (typeLines: 0) despite strict mode in jsconfig.json; response-shape changes from the 'live data' API surface only as runtime undefineds.
findings.suggestion: Add JSDoc @typedefs for the API records used by load functions (or adopt TypeScript), so the boundary is checked.

findings.issue: Declares an `error` prop it never renders; the page always claims 'Not found' even for non-404 errors, and ignores page.status.
findings.suggestion: Either render the status/message from $app/state's `page`, or drop the unused prop.

summary: This is a thoroughly modern SvelteKit 3.1.0 app: config-in-vite, #lib subpath imports, $app/state, forced runes mode and zero runtime dependencies, with all API access behind one well-cached module. The one real legacy relic is SvelteKit 2-era goto options in both interactive pages, which Kit 3 removed and silently ignores in production, causing the search input to lose focus and the page to scroll on every filter commit. Everything else is small-bore hygiene: duplicated card/CSS construction, regex URL parsing, and untyped API responses.

apis.replacement: goto(url, { reset: false, replace: true }) — SvelteKit 3 migration guide / svelte.dev/e/kit/goto_options_removed
src/env.js defineEnvVars + import from $app/env/private (Kit 3; $env/* modules are deprecated for removal in Kit 4)
